description: Build the customer's order: one garment, how many of each size in each colour, how the logo is made and where it goes. Checks stock, prices it and gives a link that opens the garment with all of that chosen. The customer adds their logo there, checks it and pays; nothing is ordered until they do.

sizes.description: How many of each size, e.g. {"M": 10, "L": 15}

method.description: How the logo is applied. Default PRINT.

position.description: Where the logo goes. Default front, the left chest.

name: build_order
title: Build an order
